taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.subtitle: Computed from the ledger. Rates can be changed — check the current ones on the tax service site.

fop.summary3: Sole proprietor, group {{group}}: single tax {{single}}, military levy {{military}} of the income, social contribution {{esv}} a month.
fop.summary12: Sole proprietor, group {{group}}: single tax {{single}} and military levy {{military}} a month, social contribution {{esv}} a month.
fop.noSources: No income of the sole proprietor: mark an account as “Sole proprietor” or choose income categories.
fop.limitHint: The limit counts in minimum wages on 1 January. Above it: 15 % of the excess and the general system.
fop.deadlines3: The quarterly declaration is filed within 40 days, the taxes are paid 10 days later. Public holidays are not counted.
fop.deadlines12: The single tax and military levy are paid monthly in advance by the 20th; the declaration once a year.
fop.incomesHint: What is not income (a refund of a wrong payment, own money) can be left out.
fop.addHint: Income on other accounts can be added in the transaction panel.

investments.summary: Personal income tax {{pdfo}} and military levy {{military}} on dividends and the profit of sales, in hryvnias at the NBU rates of the dates. Government bonds are exempt.
investments.dividendsHint: The tax withheld abroad reduces the personal income tax when its document exists.
investments.documentOf: Document of the foreign tax for {{symbol}}, {{date}}
investments.salesHint: Income at the rate of the sale, cost — the FIFO lots at the rates of their purchases, fees included. The exchange rate change is taxed too.

lines.profit: Investment profit of the year (appendix F1)
lines.carriedIn: Loss of earlier years carried over

investments.carriedOut: A loss of {{amount}} carries over to the following years.

rates.title: Rates of {{year}}
rates.subtitle: Each year has its own. The defaults can be restored.
rates.esvEnabled: I pay the minimum social contribution
rates.esvHint: Contribution a month: {{amount}}. The income limit of the group follows the minimum wage too.
rates.incomeCategories: Income categories of the sole proprietor
rates.incomeCategoriesHint: Income of these categories on any account is income of the sole proprietor, with subcategories. Income of “Sole proprietor” accounts always counts.
rates.documentDefault: Dividends without a mark have the document of the foreign tax
rates.check: The defaults may be outdated — check on
